notes: Site is a single short marketing page. Total document height ranges from 1873px (1440x900) to 2831px (320x568).
All scrolling is element-based: scroll the eyebrow label or table element to ~60-80px from viewport top.

Screenshots 03_desktop_how_it_works.png and 04_desktop_comparison_table.png are byte-identical (same MD5). At 1440x900 the document is only 1873px tall, so the page bottoms out at scrollY=973 and both 'How it works' and 'Why kombo' sections appear together; we cannot frame them separately with viewport-only screenshots. Documented honestly rather than faked.
Mobile comparison table screenshot (09) bottomed out (maxScroll=1699 vs target=2058), so the top of the frame still includes the 'How it works' cards above the table.
